concepts.definition: the main circuit board that connects and allows communication among major computer components
the processor that executes program instructions and performs arithmetic, logic, and control operations
volatile working memory used to hold data and instructions that are actively needed by the processor
a device such as an SSD or hard disk used for persistent storage of programs and data
a device that converts electrical input into regulated voltages required by computer components
an external or auxiliary device connected to a computer to provide input, output, storage, or communication
an electronic measuring instrument used to test quantities such as voltage, current, resistance, and continuity
the process of joining electronic conductors or components with a molten filler metal
an insulating board containing conductive tracks and mounted electronic components that form a circuit
a component that provides a detachable electrical or data connection between devices, cables, or circuit assemblies
